```{ojs}
//| output: false

// ===================================================================
// Shared data layer, included in every page with {{< include _load.qmd >}}.
// Loads data/database.xlsx in the browser, normalises cells, joins the
// sheets, runs the data checks and derives the rows shown on the site.
// Also holds URL state (compare selection) and shared render helpers.
// ===================================================================

workbook = FileAttachment("data/database.xlsx").xlsx()

// ---- Data contract ---------------------------------------------------

SHEET_COLUMNS = ({
  Organisations: ["org_id", "name", "org_type", "country", "city", "website", "official_domains",
    "careers_page", "contact_page", "contact_type", "visa_exempt", "visa_scope", "visa_note",
    "visa_source_url", "seed_source", "last_checked", "notes"],
  Opportunities: ["opportunity_id", "org_id", "name", "summary", "opportunity_type", "discipline_area",
    "career_stage", "funding_type", "funding_amount", "funding_currency", "funding_period",
    "funding_note", "duration_max_weeks", "duration_note", "nationality_note", "host_city",
    "location_note", "location_country", "deadline_type", "next_deadline", "application_url",
    "source_url", "source_official", "verification_status", "status_reasons", "last_checked"],
  Places: ["city", "country", "latitude", "longitude", "visa_rule", "visa_rule_source"],
  About: ["text"]
})

ENUMS = ({
  org_type: ["Intergovernmental", "UN agency", "EU institution", "International NGO", "International foundation or union"],
  visa_exempt: ["Yes", "No", "Not stated"],
  contact_type: ["general contact page", "programme or general inbox", "media/press contact page"],
  verification_status: ["Verified", "Unverified", "Excluded"],
  opportunity_type: ["Internship", "Traineeship", "Fellowship", "Travel grant", "PhD visit", "Visiting researcher"],
  discipline_area: ["STEM", "Social sciences", "Any"],
  funding_type: ["Salary", "Stipend or allowance", "Fellowship", "Grant"]
})

RESEARCH_TYPES = ["Fellowship", "Travel grant", "PhD visit", "Visiting researcher"]
SHOWN_STATUSES = ["Verified", "Unverified"]
REQUIRED_OPP_FIELDS = ["opportunity_id", "org_id", "name", "opportunity_type", "discipline_area",
  "funding_type", "duration_max_weeks", "host_city", "source_url", "verification_status", "last_checked"]
NUMERIC_COLUMNS = new Set(["latitude", "longitude", "duration_max_weeks", "funding_amount"])

DISCIPLINE_COLOURS = ({ "STEM": "#1E63C4", "Social sciences": "#D2741F", "Any": "#5E6A75" })
DISCIPLINE_LABELS = ({ "STEM": "STEM", "Social sciences": "Social sciences", "Any": "Any field" })

// ---- Cell normalisation ------------------------------------------------

function normValue(v) {
  if (v == null) return null;
  if (v instanceof Date) return isNaN(v) ? null : v.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  if (typeof v === "number") return Number.isFinite(v) ? v : null;
  if (typeof v === "boolean") return v ? "Yes" : "No";
  if (typeof v === "object") {
    if ("result" in v) return normValue(v.result);
    if (v.richText) return normValue(v.richText.map(t => t.text).join(""));
    if (v.text != null) return normValue(typeof v.text === "object" ? v.text.richText?.map(t => t.text).join("") : v.text);
    if (v.hyperlink) return normValue(v.hyperlink);
    return null;
  }
  const s = String(v).replace(/\u00a0/g, " ").trim();
  return s === "" ? null : s;
}

// Reads a sheet by its header row (row 1). Returns the non-empty rows keyed by
// header name plus any expected columns that are missing.
function readSheet(name) {
  const expected = SHEET_COLUMNS[name];
  if (!workbook.sheetNames.includes(name)) return { rows: [], missing: expected, sheetMissing: true };
  const grid = workbook.sheet(name);
  if (!grid.length) return { rows: [], missing: expected, sheetMissing: false };
  const header = {};
  for (const [col, v] of Object.entries(grid[0])) {
    const h = normValue(v);
    if (h != null) header[col] = String(h);
  }
  const present = new Set(Object.values(header));
  const rows = [];
  for (let i = 1; i < grid.length; i++) {
    const raw = grid[i];
    const r = { _row: i + 1 };
    let any = false;
    for (const [col, h] of Object.entries(header)) {
      let v = normValue(raw[col]);
      if (v != null && NUMERIC_COLUMNS.has(h) && typeof v === "string") {
        const n = Number(v.replace(/,/g, ""));
        if (Number.isFinite(n)) v = n;
      }
      if (v != null && typeof v === "number" && !NUMERIC_COLUMNS.has(h)) v = String(v);
      if (v != null) any = true;
      r[h] = v;
    }
    if (!any) continue;
    for (const c of expected) if (!(c in r)) r[c] = null;
    rows.push(r);
  }
  return { rows, missing: expected.filter(c => !present.has(c)), sheetMissing: false };
}

// ---- Small helpers ---------------------------------------------------------

function slugify(s) {
  return String(s ?? "").normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
    .toLowerCase().trim().replace(/\s+/g, "-").replace(/[^a-z0-9-]/g, "");
}

function isUrl(v) { return typeof v === "string" && /^https?:\/\//i.test(v); }

// Career-stage filters are a text match on the free-text career_stage field.
function careerText(s) { return String(s ?? "").toLowerCase().replace(/[\u2018\u2019]/g, "'"); }
function isPhdEligible(s) {
  const t = careerText(s);
  if (/phd students? (are )?not eligible|not yet in a phd/.test(t)) return false;
  return /\bph\.?d\b|doctora|post-?graduate/.test(t);
}
function isMastersEligible(s) {
  const t = careerText(s);
  return /master|post-?graduate|(^|[^a-z-])graduate (students?|or|and)\b/.test(t);
}

// A deadline is a real date when it starts with an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD).
function deadlineDate(v) {
  if (typeof v !== "string") return null;
  const m = v.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/);
  if (!m) return null;
  const d = new Date(Date.UTC(+m[1], +m[2] - 1, +m[3]));
  return isNaN(d) ? null : d;
}

function fmtDate(v, opts = { day: "numeric", month: "short", year: "numeric" }) {
  const d = v instanceof Date ? v : deadlineDate(v);
  if (!d) return v ?? "";
  return d.toLocaleDateString("en-GB", { ...opts, timeZone: "UTC" });
}

function fmtNumber(n) { return Number(n).toLocaleString("en-GB", { maximumFractionDigits: 2 }); }

function plural(n, one, many = one + "s") { return `${n} ${n === 1 ? one : many}`; }

// ---- Load, check and derive ----------------------------------------------

data = {
  const problems = [];
  const flag = (sheet, id, field, problem, hidesOpp = null) =>
    problems.push({ sheet, id: id ?? "(no id)", field, problem, hidesOpp });

  const sheets = {};
  for (const name of Object.keys(SHEET_COLUMNS)) {
    const s = readSheet(name);
    sheets[name] = s;
    if (s.sheetMissing) flag(name, "(sheet)", "-", `Sheet "${name}" not found in the workbook`);
    else for (const c of s.missing) flag(name, "(header)", c, "Column missing from the header row");
  }
  const orgsAll = sheets.Organisations.rows;
  const oppsAll = sheets.Opportunities.rows;
  const placesAll = sheets.Places.rows;
  const about = sheets.About.rows.map(r => r.text).filter(t => t != null).map(String);

  // Check 8: unique ids across all rows.
  const dupes = (rows, key) => {
    const seen = new Map();
    for (const r of rows) if (r[key] != null) seen.set(r[key], (seen.get(r[key]) ?? 0) + 1);
    return new Set([...seen].filter(([, n]) => n > 1).map(([k]) => k));
  };
  const dupOpp = dupes(oppsAll, "opportunity_id");
  const dupOrg = dupes(orgsAll, "org_id");
  for (const id of dupOpp) flag("Opportunities", id, "opportunity_id", "Duplicate opportunity_id");
  for (const id of dupOrg) flag("Organisations", id, "org_id", "Duplicate org_id");

  const orgById = new Map(orgsAll.filter(o => o.org_id != null).map(o => [o.org_id, o]));
  const placeByCity = new Map(placesAll.filter(p => p.city != null).map(p => [p.city, p]));

  // Status must be valid on every row (otherwise a record silently disappears).
  for (const o of oppsAll) {
    if (o.verification_status == null) flag("Opportunities", o.opportunity_id, "verification_status", `Missing (row ${o._row})`);
    else if (!ENUMS.verification_status.includes(o.verification_status))
      flag("Opportunities", o.opportunity_id, "verification_status", `Invalid value "${o.verification_status}"`);
  }

  const candidates = oppsAll.filter(o => SHOWN_STATUSES.includes(o.verification_status));
  const hidden = new Set();
  const fail = (o, field, problem) => {
    flag("Opportunities", o.opportunity_id, field, problem, o);
    hidden.add(o);
  };

  // Organisation-level checks, for organisations with a candidate opportunity.
  const badOrgs = new Map();
  const usedOrgIds = new Set(candidates.map(o => o.org_id).filter(Boolean));
  for (const id of usedOrgIds) {
    const g = orgById.get(id);
    if (!g) continue;
    const reasons = [];
    for (const f of ["org_type", "visa_exempt"]) {
      if (g[f] == null) reasons.push([f, "Missing"]);
      else if (!ENUMS[f].includes(g[f])) reasons.push([f, `Invalid value "${g[f]}"`]);
    }
    if (g.contact_type != null && !ENUMS.contact_type.includes(g.contact_type))
      reasons.push(["contact_type", `Invalid value "${g.contact_type}"`]);
    for (const f of ["website", "careers_page", "visa_source_url"])
      if (g[f] != null && !isUrl(g[f])) reasons.push([f, "URL must start with http"]);
    if (g.contact_page != null && !isUrl(g.contact_page) && !/^mailto:/i.test(g.contact_page))
      reasons.push(["contact_page", "Must start with http or mailto:"]);
    if (dupOrg.has(id)) reasons.push(["org_id", "Duplicate org_id"]);
    for (const [field, problem] of reasons) flag("Organisations", id, field, problem);
    if (reasons.length) badOrgs.set(id, reasons);
  }

  // Place-level checks, for host cities used by a candidate opportunity.
  const badPlaces = new Map();
  for (const city of new Set(candidates.map(o => o.host_city).filter(Boolean))) {
    const p = placeByCity.get(city);
    if (!p) continue;
    const reasons = [];
    if (typeof p.latitude !== "number" || Math.abs(p.latitude) > 90) reasons.push(["latitude", "Not a valid number"]);
    if (typeof p.longitude !== "number" || Math.abs(p.longitude) > 180) reasons.push(["longitude", "Not a valid number"]);
    if (p.country == null) reasons.push(["country", "Missing"]);
    if (p.visa_rule_source != null && !isUrl(p.visa_rule_source)) reasons.push(["visa_rule_source", "URL must start with http"]);
    for (const [field, problem] of reasons) flag("Places", city, field, problem);
    if (reasons.length) badPlaces.set(city, reasons);
  }

  // Opportunity-level checks (shown rows only).
  for (const o of candidates) {
    // 1. Required fields. duration_max_weeks may be blank on an Unverified row
    //    (an unconfirmed duration is a valid "missing detail").
    for (const f of REQUIRED_OPP_FIELDS) {
      if (o[f] != null) continue;
      if (f === "duration_max_weeks" && o.verification_status === "Unverified") continue;
      fail(o, f, "Required field is empty");
    }
    // 2. Organisation exists.
    if (o.org_id != null && !orgById.has(o.org_id)) fail(o, "org_id", `No organisation with org_id "${o.org_id}"`);
    else if (badOrgs.has(o.org_id)) fail(o, "org_id", "Its organisation row fails a check (see Organisations)");
    // 3. Host city exists in Places with coordinates.
    if (o.host_city != null && !placeByCity.has(o.host_city)) fail(o, "host_city", `"${o.host_city}" is not in Places`);
    else if (badPlaces.has(o.host_city)) fail(o, "host_city", "Its Places row has no valid coordinates (see Places)");
    // 4. Enum values.
    for (const f of ["opportunity_type", "discipline_area", "funding_type"])
      if (o[f] != null && !ENUMS[f].includes(o[f])) fail(o, f, `Invalid value "${o[f]}"`);
    // 5. Duration.
    if (o.duration_max_weeks != null) {
      if (typeof o.duration_max_weeks !== "number") fail(o, "duration_max_weeks", "Not a number");
      else if (o.duration_max_weeks > 26) fail(o, "duration_max_weeks", `${o.duration_max_weeks} weeks is over 26`);
    }
    if (o.funding_amount != null && typeof o.funding_amount !== "number") fail(o, "funding_amount", "Not a number");
    // 6. Verified rows.
    if (o.verification_status === "Verified") {
      if (o.source_official !== "Yes") fail(o, "source_official", "Must be Yes for a Verified record");
      if (o.status_reasons != null) fail(o, "status_reasons", "Must be empty for a Verified record");
    }
    // 7. Unverified rows.
    if (o.verification_status === "Unverified" && o.status_reasons == null)
      fail(o, "status_reasons", "Must name the missing detail for an Unverified record");
    // 8. Unique id.
    if (dupOpp.has(o.opportunity_id)) fail(o, "opportunity_id", "Duplicate opportunity_id");
    // 9. URLs.
    for (const f of ["source_url", "application_url"])
      if (o[f] != null && !isUrl(o[f])) fail(o, f, "URL must start with http");
  }

  // Derived shown rows.
  const opps = candidates.filter(o => !hidden.has(o)).map(o => {
    const org = orgById.get(o.org_id);
    const place = placeByCity.get(o.host_city);
    const dl = deadlineDate(o.next_deadline);
    return {
      ...o,
      id: o.opportunity_id,
      org,
      place,
      city: place.city,
      country: place.country,
      citySlug: slugify(place.city),
      countrySlug: slugify(place.country),
      isResearch: RESEARCH_TYPES.includes(o.opportunity_type),
      disciplines: o.discipline_area === "Any" ? ["STEM", "Social sciences"] : [o.discipline_area],
      phd: isPhdEligible(o.career_stage),
      masters: isMastersEligible(o.career_stage),
      hasAmount: typeof o.funding_amount === "number",
      deadline: dl,
      verified: o.verification_status === "Verified",
      visaExempt: org.visa_exempt === "Yes"
    };
  });

  const orgs = [...d3.group(opps, o => o.org_id)].map(([id, list]) => ({
    ...orgById.get(id), opps: list, slug: id
  }));

  const placeMap = d3.group(opps, o => o.city);
  const places = [...placeMap].map(([city, list]) => {
    const p = placeByCity.get(city);
    return { ...p, slug: slugify(city), countrySlug: slugify(p.country), opps: list };
  });

  const snapshot = d3.max(opps, o => o.last_checked) ?? null;

  return {
    orgsAll, oppsAll, placesAll, about, problems, hiddenCount: hidden.size,
    opps, orgs, places, snapshot, orgById, placeByCity,
    statusCounts: d3.rollup(oppsAll, v => v.length, o => o.verification_status ?? "(blank)")
  };
}

opps = data.opps
countries = d3.sort(d3.groups(opps, o => o.country), ([c]) => c).map(([country, list]) => ({
  country, slug: slugify(country), opps: list, cities: [...new Set(list.map(o => o.city))].sort()
}))

// ---- Filters (shared by Opportunities and filter-aware home) -------------------

TYPE_FILTERS = ({
  research: { label: "Research visit", test: o => o.isResearch },
  internship: { label: "Internship", test: o => o.opportunity_type === "Internship" },
  traineeship: { label: "Traineeship", test: o => o.opportunity_type === "Traineeship" }
})
STAGE_FILTERS = ({
  phd: { label: "PhD eligible", test: o => o.phd },
  masters: { label: "Master's eligible", test: o => o.masters }
})
DISCIPLINE_FILTERS = ({ "stem": "STEM", "social-sciences": "Social sciences" })
// deadline_type values; Rolling (apply any time) is the most stable, so it comes first.
DEADLINE_FILTERS = ({
  rolling: { label: "Rolling", value: "Rolling" },
  adhoc: { label: "Ad hoc vacancies", value: "Ad hoc vacancies" },
  fixed: { label: "Fixed (annual or rounds)", value: "Fixed (annual or rounds)" }
})
DEADLINE_ORDER = ["Rolling", "Ad hoc vacancies", "Fixed (annual or rounds)"]
SORTS = ({ rolling: "Rolling first", country: "Country", amount: "Amount", duration: "Duration", name: "Name", deadline: "Deadline" })
DEFAULT_SORT = "rolling"

urlParams = new URLSearchParams(location.search)

// Normalises raw URL parameters into the filter state.
function readFilterState(p) {
  const get = k => (p.get(k) ?? "").trim();
  const lower = k => get(k).toLowerCase();
  const disc = slugify(get("discipline"));
  const truthy = k => ["1", "yes", "true"].includes(lower(k));
  return {
    q: get("q"),
    discipline: DISCIPLINE_FILTERS[disc] ? disc : "",
    type: TYPE_FILTERS[lower("type")] ? lower("type") : "",
    stage: STAGE_FILTERS[lower("stage")] ? lower("stage") : "",
    country: slugify(get("country")),
    deadline: DEADLINE_FILTERS[lower("deadline")] ? lower("deadline") : "",
    verified: truthy("verified"),
    visa: truthy("visa"),
    amount: truthy("amount"),
    sort: SORTS[lower("sort")] ? lower("sort") : DEFAULT_SORT,
    view: lower("view") === "organisations" ? "organisations" : "opportunities"
  };
}

function filterParams(f) {
  return {
    q: f.q || null, discipline: f.discipline || null, type: f.type || null, stage: f.stage || null,
    country: f.country || null, deadline: f.deadline || null, verified: f.verified ? "1" : null, visa: f.visa ? "1" : null,
    amount: f.amount ? "1" : null, sort: f.sort && f.sort !== DEFAULT_SORT ? f.sort : null,
    view: f.view === "organisations" ? "organisations" : null
  };
}

function matchesSearch(o, q) {
  if (!q) return true;
  const hay = [o.name, o.org?.name, o.summary, o.city, o.country, o.location_note]
    .filter(Boolean).join(" ").toLowerCase();
  return q.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).every(w => hay.includes(w));
}

function applyFilters(rows, f) {
  return rows.filter(o =>
    matchesSearch(o, f.q) &&
    (!f.discipline || o.disciplines.includes(DISCIPLINE_FILTERS[f.discipline])) &&
    (!f.type || TYPE_FILTERS[f.type].test(o)) &&
    (!f.stage || STAGE_FILTERS[f.stage].test(o)) &&
    (!f.country || o.countrySlug === f.country) &&
    (!f.deadline || o.deadline_type === DEADLINE_FILTERS[f.deadline].value) &&
    (!f.verified || o.verified) &&
    (!f.visa || o.visaExempt) &&
    (!f.amount || o.hasAmount));
}

// Plain-language list of the active filters, for result counts and empty states.
function describeFilters(f) {
  const out = [];
  if (f.q) out.push(`search "${f.q}"`);
  if (f.discipline) out.push(`discipline: ${DISCIPLINE_FILTERS[f.discipline]}`);
  if (f.type) out.push(`type: ${TYPE_FILTERS[f.type].label}`);
  if (f.stage) out.push(STAGE_FILTERS[f.stage].label);
  if (f.country) out.push(`country: ${countries.find(c => c.slug === f.country)?.country ?? f.country}`);
  if (f.deadline) out.push(`deadline: ${DEADLINE_FILTERS[f.deadline].label}`);
  if (f.verified) out.push("verified only");
  if (f.visa) out.push("visa-exempt: yes");
  if (f.amount) out.push("amount stated");
  return out;
}

function sortRows(rows, sort) {
  const byName = (a, b) => d3.ascending(a.name, b.name);
  const byCountry = (a, b) => d3.ascending(a.country, b.country) || d3.ascending(a.org.name, b.org.name) || byName(a, b);
  const nullsLast = (a, b, fa, fb) => (a == null) - (b == null) || fa(a, b);
  const deadlineRank = o => { const i = DEADLINE_ORDER.indexOf(o.deadline_type); return i < 0 ? DEADLINE_ORDER.length : i; };
  const cmp = {
    rolling: (a, b) => d3.ascending(deadlineRank(a), deadlineRank(b)) || byCountry(a, b),
    country: byCountry,
    name: (a, b) => byName(a, b) || byCountry(a, b),
    // Amounts compare only within the same currency and period; highest first.
    amount: (a, b) => (b.hasAmount - a.hasAmount)
      || d3.ascending(a.funding_currency ?? "~", b.funding_currency ?? "~")
      || d3.ascending(a.funding_period ?? "~", b.funding_period ?? "~")
      || d3.descending(a.funding_amount, b.funding_amount) || byCountry(a, b),
    duration: (a, b) => nullsLast(a.duration_max_weeks, b.duration_max_weeks, d3.descending) || byCountry(a, b),
    deadline: (a, b) => nullsLast(a.deadline, b.deadline, d3.ascending) || byCountry(a, b)
  }[sort] ?? byCountry;
  // (place and organisation pages pass "country"; the Opportunities list defaults to "rolling")
  return [...rows].sort(cmp);
}

// ---- URL helpers --------------------------------------------------------------

// Builds a readable query string (commas and spaces kept legible). Null values are dropped.
function qs(params) {
  const parts = [];
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(params)) {
    if (v == null || v === "") continue;
    parts.push(`${encodeURIComponent(k)}=${encodeURIComponent(v).replace(/%2C/gi, ",").replace(/%20/g, "+")}`);
  }
  return parts.length ? "?" + parts.join("&") : "";
}

// Replaces the given keys in the current URL without reloading or adding history entries.
function updateUrl(changes) {
  const p = Object.fromEntries(new URLSearchParams(location.search));
  Object.assign(p, changes);
  history.replaceState(history.state, "", location.pathname + qs(p) + location.hash);
}

// ---- Compare selection (held in ?compare=) ----------------------------------------

compareStore = {
  const valid = new Set(opps.map(o => o.id));
  let ids = [...new Set((urlParams.get("compare") ?? "").split(",").map(s => s.trim()).filter(s => valid.has(s)))].slice(0, 3);
  const subs = new Set();
  const set = next => {
    ids = next.slice(0, 3);
    updateUrl({ compare: ids.length ? ids.join(",") : null });
    for (const f of subs) f(ids.slice());
  };
  return {
    get: () => ids.slice(),
    has: id => ids.includes(id),
    set,
    remove: id => set(ids.filter(x => x !== id)),
    add(id, opener) {
      if (ids.includes(id)) return;
      if (ids.length < 3) return set([...ids, id]);
      askReplace(id, ids, replaced => set(ids.map(x => (x === replaced ? id : x))), opener);
    },
    subscribe(f) { subs.add(f); return () => subs.delete(f); }
  };
}

compareIds = Generators.observe(notify => {
  notify(compareStore.get());
  return compareStore.subscribe(notify);
})

// Asks which of the three selected opportunities to replace (native modal dialog).
function askReplace(newId, current, onReplace, opener) {
  const byId = id => opps.find(o => o.id === id);
  const dlg = htl.html`<dialog class="replace-dialog" aria-labelledby="replace-title">
    <h2 id="replace-title">Compare holds three opportunities</h2>
    <p>Choose one to replace with <strong>${byId(newId)?.name}</strong>.</p>
    <div class="replace-options">
      ${current.map(id => htl.html`<button type="button" class="btn-replace" onclick=${() => { dlg.close(); onReplace(id); }}>
        Replace ${byId(id)?.name} <span class="muted">(${byId(id)?.org.name})</span></button>`)}
      <button type="button" class="btn-plain" onclick=${() => dlg.close()}>Cancel</button>
    </div>
  </dialog>`;
  dlg.addEventListener("close", () => { dlg.remove(); opener?.focus(); });
  document.body.append(dlg);
  dlg.showModal();
}

// Keeps ?compare= on every internal link, so the selection follows the visitor.
compareLinks = {
  const fix = e => {
    const a = e.target?.closest?.("a[href]");
    if (!a || a.hasAttribute("data-no-state")) return;
    const url = new URL(a.getAttribute("href"), location.href);
    if (url.origin !== location.origin || !/(\.html|\/)$/.test(url.pathname)) return;
    const p = Object.fromEntries(url.searchParams);
    const ids = compareStore.get();
    p.compare = ids.length ? ids.join(",") : null;
    a.setAttribute("href", url.pathname + qs(p) + url.hash);
  };
  const types = ["pointerdown", "focusin", "click", "auxclick"];
  for (const t of types) document.addEventListener(t, fix, true);
  invalidation.then(() => { for (const t of types) document.removeEventListener(t, fix, true); });
  return true;
}

// Navbar: "Compare (n)" link reflects the selection.
navCompare = {
  for (const a of document.querySelectorAll('a.nav-link[href*="#compare"]')) {
    const label = a.querySelector(".menu-text") ?? a;
    label.textContent = `Compare (${compareIds.length})`;
    a.setAttribute("aria-label", `Compare, ${plural(compareIds.length, "opportunity", "opportunities")} selected`);
    a.setAttribute("href", "opportunities.html" + qs({ compare: compareIds.join(",") || null }) + "#compare");
    a.classList.remove("active");
    a.removeAttribute("aria-current");
  }
  return compareIds.length;
}

// Footer: copyright (static, in _quarto.yml) + snapshot date (latest last_checked among shown records).
footerSnapshot = {
  const el = document.querySelector(".nav-footer-center");
  if (!el) return;
  el.querySelector(".snapshot")?.remove();
  if (data.snapshot) (el.querySelector("p") ?? el).append(htl.html`<span class="snapshot"> · Data checked up to ${fmtDate(data.snapshot, { day: "numeric", month: "long", year: "numeric" })}</span>`);
  return data.snapshot;
}

// Repository (for "Report an issue"): derived from the github.io address when hosted.
REPO_URL = {
  const m = location.hostname.match(/^([^.]+)\.github\.io$/i);
  if (!m) return null;
  const first = location.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean)[0];
  const repo = first && !first.endsWith(".html") ? first : `${m[1]}.github.io`;
  return `https://github.com/${m[1]}/${repo}`;
}

// Opens the "Report a record" issue form (.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/report-record.yml), prefilled for one record.
// Reports arrive as GitHub Issues; no email address is shown on the site.
function issueUrl(o) {
  if (!REPO_URL) return null;
  return `${REPO_URL}/issues/new` + qs({
    template: "report-record.yml",
    title: `Record ${o.id}: ${o.name}`,
    record: `${o.id}: ${o.name} (${o.org.name})`,
    source: o.source_url
  });
}

REPORT_FORM_URL = REPO_URL ? `${REPO_URL}/issues/new?template=report-record.yml` : null

// ---- Render helpers ----------------------------------------------------------------

orgHref = id => `organisation.html${qs({ org: id })}`
cityHref = slug => `place.html${qs({ city: slug })}`
countryHref = slug => `place.html${qs({ country: slug })}`

function fundingSummary(o) {
  if (!o.hasAmount) return "amount not stated";
  const period = o.funding_period ? ` ${o.funding_period.toLowerCase()}` : "";
  return `${o.funding_currency ? o.funding_currency + " " : ""}${fmtNumber(o.funding_amount)}${period}`;
}

// funding_note without a trailing "(amount not stated)": the card already says so next to the funding type.
function fundingNote(o) {
  const t = (o.funding_note ?? "").replace(/\s*\(amount not stated\)\s*$/i, "").trim();
  return t || null;
}

function durationText(o) {
  if (o.duration_note) return o.duration_note;
  if (o.duration_max_weeks != null) return `Up to ${o.duration_max_weeks} weeks`;
  return "Duration not confirmed";
}

function visaText(org) {
  const scope = org.visa_scope ? `, in ${org.visa_scope}` : "";
  if (org.visa_exempt === "Yes") return `Visa-exempt: yes${scope}`;
  if (org.visa_exempt === "No") return `Visa-exempt: no${scope}`;
  return "Visa exemption not stated";
}

function deadlineText(o) {
  const parts = [];
  if (o.next_deadline) parts.push(o.deadline && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(o.next_deadline) ? fmtDate(o.next_deadline) : o.next_deadline);
  if (o.deadline_type) parts.push(o.deadline_type);
  return parts.length ? parts.join(" · ") : "Not stated";
}

function disciplineTag(d) {
  return htl.html`<span class="disc-tag" style=${{ "--disc": DISCIPLINE_COLOURS[d] }}><span class="disc-dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>${DISCIPLINE_LABELS[d]}</span>`;
}

function statusBadge(o) {
  return o.verified
    ? htl.html`<span class="badge-verified">Verified</span>`
    : htl.html`<span class="badge-unverified">Unverified</span>`;
}

ICON_EXTERNAL = () => htl.svg`<svg class="icon" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 2h5v5M14 2 7.5 8.5M12 9.5V14H2V4h4.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>`

function extLink(href, text) {
  return htl.html`<a href=${href} target="_blank" rel="noopener" data-no-state>${text}${ICON_EXTERNAL()}<span class="visually-hidden"> (opens in a new tab)</span></a>`;
}

// Official pages move (vacancy links expire), so each card offers a standing
// organisation page as a fallback when it differs from the record's own links.
function fallbackLink(o) {
  const used = new Set([o.source_url, o.application_url].filter(Boolean));
  if (isUrl(o.org.careers_page) && !used.has(o.org.careers_page)) return { url: o.org.careers_page, text: "the organisation's careers page" };
  if (isUrl(o.org.website) && !used.has(o.org.website)) return { url: o.org.website, text: "the organisation's website" };
  return null;
}

// Opportunity card. Field order follows the build brief.
function oppCard(o, { headingLevel = 3, showOrg = true } = {}) {
  const h = headingLevel === 4 ? htl.html`<h4 class="opp-name">${o.name}</h4>` : htl.html`<h3 class="opp-name">${o.name}</h3>`;
  const issue = issueUrl(o);
  const selected = compareStore.has(o.id);
  const fallback = fallbackLink(o);
  return htl.html`<article class="opp-card" id=${"opp-" + o.id} data-id=${o.id}>
    ${h}
    ${showOrg ? htl.html`<p class="opp-org"><a href=${orgHref(o.org_id)}>${o.org.name}</a></p>` : null}
    <p class="opp-place"><a href=${cityHref(o.citySlug)}>${o.city}</a>, <a href=${countryHref(o.countrySlug)}>${o.country}</a>${o.location_note && o.location_note !== o.city ? htl.html`<span class="muted"> · ${o.location_note}</span>` : null}</p>
    <p class="opp-tags"><span class="type-tag">${o.opportunity_type}</span>${o.isResearch ? htl.html`<span class="research-tag">Research visit</span>` : null}${disciplineTag(o.discipline_area)}</p>
    <dl class="opp-facts">
      <div><dt>Funding</dt><dd>${o.funding_type} · ${o.hasAmount ? htl.html`<strong>${fundingSummary(o)}</strong>` : htl.html`<span class="muted">amount not stated</span>`}${fundingNote(o) ? htl.html`<span class="fact-detail">${fundingNote(o)}</span>` : null}</dd></div>
      <div><dt>Duration</dt><dd>${durationText(o)}</dd></div>
      <div><dt>Career stage</dt><dd>${o.career_stage ?? "Not stated"}</dd></div>
      ${o.nationality_note ? htl.html`<div><dt>Eligibility</dt><dd>${o.nationality_note}</dd></div>` : null}
    </dl>
    <div class="opp-status">${statusBadge(o)}${o.verified ? null : htl.html`<p class="unverified-note"><strong>Still to confirm:</strong> ${o.status_reasons}. Confirm nationality and right-to-work terms in the current vacancy notice before applying.</p>`}</div>
    <dl class="opp-facts">
      <div><dt>Visa</dt><dd>${visaText(o.org)}</dd></div>
      <div><dt>Deadline</dt><dd>${deadlineText(o)}</dd></div>
    </dl>
    <p class="opp-links">${extLink(o.source_url, "Official source")}${o.application_url && o.application_url !== o.source_url ? extLink(o.application_url, "Apply") : null}<span class="link-age">checked ${fmtDate(o.last_checked)}</span></p>
    ${fallback ? htl.html`<p class="link-fallback">Link not working? Try ${extLink(fallback.url, fallback.text)}.</p>` : null}
    <div class="opp-foot">
      ${issue ? htl.html`<a class="muted" href=${issue} target="_blank" rel="noopener" data-no-state>Report an issue<span class="visually-hidden"> with ${o.name} (opens in a new tab)</span></a>` : null}
      <button type="button" class="btn-compare" data-compare=${o.id} aria-pressed=${selected ? "true" : "false"}>${selected ? "Remove from compare" : "Add to compare"}</button>
    </div>
  </article>`;
}

// Wires "Add to compare" buttons inside a container; keeps their state in sync.
function wireCompare(container, invalidation) {
  const sync = () => {
    for (const b of container.querySelectorAll("button[data-compare]")) {
      const on = compareStore.has(b.dataset.compare);
      b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", on ? "true" : "false");
      b.textContent = on ? "Remove from compare" : "Add to compare";
    }
  };
  container.addEventListener("click", e => {
    const b = e.target.closest("button[data-compare]");
    if (!b) return;
    const id = b.dataset.compare;
    if (compareStore.has(id)) compareStore.remove(id);
    else compareStore.add(id, b);
  });
  sync();
  const off = compareStore.subscribe(sync);
  invalidation?.then(off);
  return container;
}

// ---- Map helpers (Leaflet is loaded only on pages with a map) ---------------------------

// OpenStreetMap standard tiles (no API key; usage policy: https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/tiles/).
// Shown in greyscale via CSS for a light basemap.
TILE_URL = "https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png"
TILE_ATTRIBUTION = '&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a> contributors'

// Capped square-root scale for marker radius (px); at least 24px across (WCAG target size).
function markerRadius(n, max) {
  const r = 12 + 18 * Math.sqrt(n / Math.max(max, 1));
  return Math.min(30, Math.round(r));
}

// One summary row per city for the given opportunities.
function citySummaries(rows) {
  return d3.sort([...d3.group(rows, o => o.city)].map(([city, list]) => {
    const p = data.placeByCity.get(city);
    return {
      city, slug: slugify(city), country: p.country, countrySlug: slugify(p.country),
      lat: p.latitude, lng: p.longitude, n: list.length,
      verified: list.filter(o => o.verified).length,
      byDisc: Object.fromEntries(["STEM", "Social sciences", "Any"].map(d => [d, list.filter(o => o.discipline_area === d).length])),
      visaRule: p.visa_rule, visaSource: p.visa_rule_source
    };
  }), c => -c.n, c => c.city);
}

// Creates a Leaflet map inside `el` (already in the document) and returns it.
function createMap(L, el, { interactive = true } = {}) {
  const map = L.map(el, {
    zoomControl: interactive, scrollWheelZoom: false, dragging: interactive, keyboard: interactive,
    doubleClickZoom: interactive, boxZoom: false, touchZoom: interactive, minZoom: 3, maxZoom: 12,
    attributionControl: true
  });
  map.setView([50, 10], 4);
  // Recompute the size once laid out (and whenever the container resizes).
  const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => map.invalidateSize());
  ro.observe(el);
  map.on("unload", () => ro.disconnect());
  // Tiles load after the page's figures have painted.
  requestAnimationFrame(() => setTimeout(() => {
    L.tileLayer(TILE_URL, { attribution: TILE_ATTRIBUTION, maxZoom: 12 }).addTo(map);
  }, 50));
  return map;
}

// Draws city markers (focusable, keyboard-operable links). Returns the layer.
function drawCityMarkers(L, map, cities, { labelMin = 3, maxN, fit = true, dim = false } = {}) {
  const layer = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);
  const max = maxN ?? d3.max(cities, c => c.n) ?? 1;
  for (const c of cities) {
    const r = markerRadius(c.n, max);
    const label = c.n >= labelMin ? `<span class="city-marker-label">${c.city}</span>` : "";
    const icon = L.divIcon({
      className: "city-marker" + (dim ? " is-dim" : ""),
      html: `<span class="city-marker-dot" style="width:${2 * r}px;height:${2 * r}px">${r >= 12 ? c.n : ""}</span>${label}`,
      iconSize: [2 * r, 2 * r], iconAnchor: [r, r]
    });
    const m = L.marker([c.lat, c.lng], { icon, keyboard: true, riseOnHover: true, title: "" }).addTo(layer);
    const disc = ["STEM", "Social sciences", "Any"].filter(d => c.byDisc[d])
      .map(d => `${DISCIPLINE_LABELS[d]} ${c.byDisc[d]}`).join(" · ");
    m.bindTooltip(`<strong>${c.city}, ${c.country}</strong><br>${plural(c.n, "opportunity", "opportunities")} (${c.verified} verified)<br>${disc}<br><span class="tt-visa">${c.visaRule ?? "No host-country rule recorded."}</span><br><span class="tt-link">Open the ${c.city} page</span>`,
      { direction: "top", offset: [0, -r], className: "city-tooltip", opacity: 1 });
    m.on("click", () => { location.href = "place.html" + qs({ city: c.slug, compare: compareStore.get().join(",") || null }); });
    const el = m.getElement();
    if (el) {
      el.setAttribute("role", "link");
      el.setAttribute("aria-label", `${c.city}, ${c.country}: ${plural(c.n, "opportunity", "opportunities")}. Open city page.`);
      el.addEventListener("focus", () => m.openTooltip());
      el.addEventListener("blur", () => m.closeTooltip());
    }
  }
  if (fit && cities.length) {
    const b = L.latLngBounds(cities.map(c => [c.lat, c.lng]));
    map.fitBounds(b.pad(0.15), { maxZoom: cities.length === 1 ? 9 : 6 });
  }
  return layer;
}

// Accessible table alternative for the map.
function cityTable(cities, caption) {
  return htl.html`<div class="table-scroll"><table class="data-table">
    <caption>${caption}</caption>
    <thead><tr><th scope="col">City</th><th scope="col">Country</th><th scope="col" class="num">Opportunities</th><th scope="col" class="num">Verified</th><th scope="col" class="num">STEM</th><th scope="col" class="num">Social sciences</th><th scope="col" class="num">Any field</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>${cities.map(c => htl.html`<tr>
      <th scope="row"><a href=${cityHref(c.slug)}>${c.city}</a></th>
      <td><a href=${countryHref(c.countrySlug)}>${c.country}</a></td>
      <td class="num">${c.n}</td><td class="num">${c.verified}</td>
      <td class="num">${c.byDisc.STEM}</td><td class="num">${c.byDisc["Social sciences"]}</td><td class="num">${c.byDisc.Any}</td>
    </tr>`)}</tbody>
  </table></div>`;
}

// Horizontal bar list with visible labels and values (doubles as its own data table).
function barList(items, { colour = () => "var(--accent)", href = null } = {}) {
  const max = d3.max(items, d => d.value) || 1;
  return htl.html`<ul class="bar-list">${items.map(d => htl.html`<li>
    <div class="bar-row"><span>${href ? htl.html`<a href=${href(d)}>${d.label}</a>` : d.label}</span><strong>${d.value}</strong></div>
    <div class="bar-track" aria-hidden="true"><div class="bar-fill" style=${{ width: `${(100 * d.value) / max}%`, background: colour(d) }}></div></div>
  </li>`)}</ul>`;
}

function notFound(what, back) {
  return htl.html`<div class="tile not-found" role="status">
    <h1>${what} not found</h1>
    <p>This link does not match anything in the current data. It may have been renamed or removed.</p>
    <p>${back}</p>
  </div>`;
}

function setTitle(t) { document.title = `${t} – International Organisation Internship Opportunities`; }
```
